source.description: Regression contract derived from the plugin/no-plugin comparison. The raw gameplay video is not stored in this repository.

requiredBehaviors.requirement: Do not recommend Echo Relocation when HUD or prior-use evidence shows that it is on cooldown.
Do not penalize inventory opening count alone; require lost movement, exposure, time, or a missed combat window.
Treat 25-27m as a scene measurement, not a general trade-distance threshold.
Do not rank gunfire over an unidentified grenade or ability without confirmed action or effect evidence.
Separate health and shield; do not infer D.O.C. deployment, reachability, or completion time from a subtitle.
Use conditional branches when unreviewed audio could change whether to heal or hold an entry.
Do not recommend firing, weapon swapping, or another required input while that control is unavailable during an ability phase.
Do not use events visible after decision commitment or unknown input-availability time as evidence of slow reaction.
Do not identify tactical cooldown or ultimate progress from a percentage without high confidence and multiple visual cue types.
Keep interrupted revives and squad elimination consistent between final-frame evidence and the reader-facing outcome.
Reject numeric thresholds and absolute claims introduced only in reader-facing prose.
Represent a sound purpose and risky execution as separate findings even when they share a timestamp.
Keep evidence-backed findings about the revive-window wide swing, staged retreat, and failure to convert safety into an attempted reset.
Do not rate a mechanically available alternative better until current purpose, prerequisites, plan preservation, opportunity cost, and the tradeoff are established.
Do not rate a weapon or firing alternative confirmed better without target visibility, line of sight, a reachable firing position, an open trade window, and a route to effect.
Do not publish delay or missed-early-opportunity claims without a reaction assessment and established perception and control-availability times.
Split setup, activation, transit, and landing instead of collapsing a multi-phase interval to neutral.
